title: Do Firms Proactively Build Internal Markets for Redeployment? Evidence from a Natural Experiment
eligible_reason: Single event date: treated_GER = 1 for retailer-country observations in Germany, after_2006 = 1 if year > 2006 (real-data do file lines 133-136), i.e. the 2006 German real estate transfer tax reform with one common post date for all treated units. Main DiDs regress RD_status (related diversification, linear probability) on treated_GER##after_2006 (or ##year event study) with country and year dummies and firm/country time-varying controls; other columns add triple interactions with lease intensity or large-store share. Not staggered. Real firm-level data are licensed (Edge Retail Insight, Compustat) and only mock data are shipped.
design_notes: Stata reg/xtreg. Panel of retailer-country-year observations from Edge Retail Insight (1997-2010). reg RD_status i.treated_GER##i.after_2006 [controls] i.year i.country, vce(cluster country); xtreg ..., fe. Event study i.treated_GER##i.year. Mock data folder (2_Mock data analysis) with made-up starting sample and firm controls for 10 retailers.
data_files_note: Readme: analysis relies on licensed Edge Retail Insight and Compustat data; only country controls (public) and made-up mock data are shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Single reform date (2006) with Germany as the only treated country; mock data only.
